title: "Navdeep Rana"

Hi there, I am Navdeep Rana. I am a physicist currently working as a postdoctoral fellow at
[MPI-DS](https://www.ds.mpg.de/en), Göttingen, Germany. My research interests lie broadly in the field of soft condensed
matter physics. In particular I am interested in problems related to active matter, turbulence,
population dynamics of growing bacterial colonies, and high-performance computing. Here is my [CV](cv.qmd)
and here are my [research interests](research.qmd).

To learn more about Quarto websites visit <https://quarto.org/docs/websites>.
